authorization.initial_offer_decision: Rail Pierce, Scatter Fan, Arc Coil; default three choices; Kinetic Pulse excluded from initial offer

player_promise: Arc Coil visibly chains from a first legal locked enemy to later legal enemies in the same immutable snapshot, with a distinct industrial electric identity.

state_ownership.presentation: runtime/main.gd consumes adapter hit_trace and does not select chain targets

delivery_rule.arc_chain: The first legal target is hop 0 with source_id -1. Every later legal target within attack_max_targets is a later hop sourced from the immediately previous legal hop. If hop 0 is invalid, no later hop may be created.

sfx: single attack sound per Arc Coil chain

reset: _auto_restart clears Arc Coil build state and all active chain transient nodes.

l2: chain trace with hop 0 and hop 1
viewport capture bound to candidate identity
evidence.l3: Protected native window capture when session lease and foreground identity guard are available.
evidence.does_not_prove: user acceptance, all M4 weapons/passives, or complete 20-minute build balance
